caption:
am.sarii from the NYC community is building Retailspoint POS, a restaurant management system. Waiters take orders on a tablet, the kitchen gets an automatic 80mm thermal ticket, stock and item-wise sales reports sit in one place, and the owner can open the dashboard from anywhere in a browser. The web POS is live. The desktop app is almost done.

Live site: https://retailspoint.com
Web POS: https://pos.retailspoint.com

Save this for the first time a restaurant owner asks if you can make billing software. Send it to the friend who still writes orders on a notepad.
